name: std/task
readme: Import this module with use task.

files.content:
-- Declares task execution and networking.
--- Runtime-selected concurrency without function coloring ---
--- Scoped execution currently uses native threads on every backend. ---
public define Executor as opaque.
public define Channel as opaque.
public define Scope as opaque.
public define Pool as opaque.
public define Net as opaque.
public define Socket as opaque.
public use "task" function backend giving integer 8.
public use "task" function which giving pointer to byte.
public use "task" function executor giving failable pointer to Executor.
public use "task" function block(callback function giving nothing for c) giving nothing.
public use "task" function channel giving failable pointer to Channel.
public use "task" function send(channel pointer to Channel, value integer) giving boolean.
public use "task" function receive(channel pointer to Channel, output pointer to integer) giving boolean.
public use "task" function scope giving failable pointer to Scope.
public use "task" function launch(scope pointer to Scope, callback function taking (integer) giving nothing for c, argument integer) giving boolean.
public use "task" function join(scope pointer to Scope) giving nothing.
public use "task" function pool giving failable pointer to Pool.
public use "task" function submit(pool pointer to Pool, callback function taking (integer) giving nothing for c, argument integer) giving boolean.
public use "task" function wait(pool pointer to Pool) giving nothing.
public use "task" function affinity(cpu integer) giving boolean.
public use "task" function label(name text) giving boolean.
public use "task" function net(executor pointer to Executor) giving pointer to Net.
public use "task" function kind(net pointer to Net) giving integer 8.
public use "task" function listen(net pointer to Net, port integer 32) giving pointer to Socket.
public use "task" function connect(net pointer to Net, host pointer to byte, port integer 32) giving pointer to Socket.
public use "task" function pull(socket pointer to Socket, buffer pointer to byte, size integer) giving integer.
public use "task" function push(socket pointer to Socket, buffer pointer to byte, size integer) giving boolean.
